lowest_kept.name: Moria Gate Arch and Mirror Tarn Loop

lowest_kept_note: Eight kept spots and several new ones have 0 Wikipedia views (no article or a redirect): Charming Creek, Monro Beach, Oparara Arch, Moria Gate and others stand on two counted sources or a DOC page, not views; so every left-out candidate with any views is listed below.

stronger_left_out.name: Hokitika
stronger_left_out.reason: Already a destination (hokitika-* spots; its header uses Hokitika River in Hokitika, which I could not reuse anyway). Do not add as a spot.

stronger_left_out.name: Greymouth
stronger_left_out.reason: Already a destination in the app (greymouth-* spots, header Greymouth town.jpg). A town is not a spot of itself; do not add. Qualifies as a place, so this is not a quality reject.

stronger_left_out.name: Westport
stronger_left_out.reason: Already a destination (westport-* spots, Cape Foulwind header). Do not add as a spot.

stronger_left_out.name: Punakaiki
stronger_left_out.reason: Confirmed: village inside Paparoa National Park (Wikivoyage chapter exists, but COVERAGE merges villages into the park); its draws (Pancake Rocks, Truman, Pororari, Cavern) are separate spots. No distinct draw of its own.

stronger_left_out.name: Haast
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage chapter, DOC Awarua/Haast Visitor Centre, jetboat safaris, last settlement before the pass. Against: its See section is generic; the draws (Ship Creek, Monro Beach, Jackson Bay) are separate spots. A gateway whose draw is the journey beyond: review (Pipiriki benchmark).

stronger_left_out.name: Murchison
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage chapter, Buller Gorge rafting base, tiny museum. Against: See section is one tiny museum; Wikivoyage does not give it a real stop. Also overlaps the Tasman region (Murchison is a Tasman-side destination candidate): decide once. Review.

stronger_left_out.name: Kahurangi National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Confirmed: a national park is a destination, not a spot (COVERAGE granularity). Westland and Paparoa already exist as destinations; Kahurangi too.

stronger_left_out.name: Karamea
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage chapter, end-of-road village, base for Oparara, Heaphy, caves. Against: the village has only a small museum open summer afternoons; Oparara/Heaphy are spots. Gateway village, review.

stronger_left_out.name: Granity
stronger_left_out.reason: Former mining village with a Wikivoyage listing only; nothing to see or do for half an hour.

stronger_left_out.name: Paparoa National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Confirmed: a national park is a destination, not a spot (COVERAGE granularity). Westland and Paparoa already exist as destinations; Kahurangi too.

benchmark: West Coast has none of the named benchmark places (those are other regions). Negative benchmarks: gateway villages whose draw is the journey beyond (Haast, Karamea, Blackball, Jackson Bay, Lyell: the Pipiriki analogue) went to review, not kept outright; civic and operator venues (Haast Visitor Centre, National Kiwi Centre, Hokitika Glass Studio, Sock World) rejected; towns that are existing destinations (Greymouth, Hokitika, Westport) and villages inside parks (Punakaiki, Franz Josef) rejected as spots. Held for a photo: Tatare Tunnels Walk, Croesus Track, Whataroa White Heron Colony, Carters Beach.
